wikipedia.subtitle: Select your preferred Wikipedia package
wikipedia.downloading: Downloading Wikipedia... This may take a while for larger packages.
wikipedia.failed: Wikipedia download failed. Select a package and try again.

tiers.intro: Select a tier based on your storage capacity and needs. Higher tiers include all content from lower tiers.
tiers.embedEstimate: +~{{size}} of additional storage if these are indexed for the AI Assistant
tiers.embedEstimateUnknown: (estimate excludes some files we have no prior data for)
tiers.autoIndexAlways: Your Auto-index setting is Always, so these files will be indexed automatically once downloaded. You can change this in the Knowledge Base settings.
tiers.autoIndexManual: Your Auto-index setting is Manual, so these files will sit unindexed until you opt in from the Knowledge Base settings.
tiers.changeAnyTime: You can change your selection at any time. Click Submit to confirm your choice.

appUrl.title: Set Custom URL
appUrl.body: Set where {{app}} opens from — useful if you reach it through a reverse proxy or local DNS. Leave this empty to use the default address ({{address}}).
appUrl.label: Custom URL
appUrl.invalid: Enter a valid http(s) address (e.g. https://jellyfin.myhomelab.net). A bare host like "jellyfin.lan" becomes http://jellyfin.lan.

updateService.title: Update Service
updateService.question: Update {{app}} from {{from}} to {{to}}?
updateService.preserved: Your data and configuration will be preserved during the update.
updateService.majorWarning: It's not recommended to upgrade to a new major version (e.g. 1.8.2 → 2.0.0) unless you have verified compatibility with your current configuration. Always review the release notes and test in a staging environment if possible.

customApp.name: Display Name
customApp.categoryHelp: Select the most relevant category for this app. This helps with visual organization and filtering.
customApp.iconHelp: Pick an icon shown on the app card.
customApp.noPorts: No port mappings — the app won't be accessible from a browser.
customApp.portsHelp: Host ports should be in the 8600+ range. Custom apps get ports starting at {{port}}.
customApp.noVolumes: No volumes — data won't persist across restarts.
customApp.limitsHelp: Caps prevent a runaway container from starving the host. Leave blank to use the defaults (1024 MB / 1 CPU).
customApp.portUsedBy: Currently bound by: {{usedBy}}. Installation may fail.
customApp.footer: Containers are created with <c>--restart=unless-stopped</c>. Data is not persisted unless you add volume mounts above.
